datasheet: Nexperia SOT883 package information (20 May 2022) p2 outline DFN1006-3 (D 0.6 x E 1.0, e 0.35, e1 0.65) and p3 'Footprint information for reflow soldering' (lands 0.40 x 0.25 at 0.45 pitch, 0.40 x 0.70, 0.70 between columns, R0.05); p23/merge/od/dl/ap/SOT883.pdf
derivation: The AP1606 data sheet (${OPENDRONE_LIB}/datasheet/AP1606.pdf, also LCSC C2849580) has no package drawing; LCSC lists DFN-3L(0.6x1), i.e. the industry DFN1006-3 (SOT883, JEITA SC-101). Land = Nexperia's SOT883 reflow footprint drawn in the OpenDrone '-BR' frame (pins 1/2 right column, pin 1 lower right, pin 3 left), which keeps the pin numbering OpenDrone built with on OpenFC-Core/Lite/Lite-Mini (PARTS-USED.md). Inside the budget envelope DFN1006 1.1 x 0.7.
